correctness.rationale: The 20 centered vertices all have length √3 and each has three adjacent edge vectors with dot product √5; antipodal symmetry gives W=2h_D(U). Each spherical vertex normal cone has three great-circle sides with 120° azimuth separation and tan inradius q=φ^-2=(3−√5)/2, with maximal polar angle arctan(2q). For polar θ, admissible aperture is 2π for θ≤arctan q, 2π−6 arccos(q cotθ) up to arctan(2q), zero outside. Transform w=2√3 cosθ across 20 cells normalized by 4π: density 5/√3[1−(3/π)arccos(qs/√(1−s²))] between s0,s1 and 5/√3 from s1 to 1; CDF follows differentiating atan(z/q)−sβ, whose derivative is −β. Independently checked s0=lower width 2.752763840942347, transition 3.23606797749979, tail mass 0.658276410373. Inspected entire verify.py, which numerically tests moment, normalization and grid but is not a proof of continuous statements.
